🚀 Krea 2 工作流程 v1.4 |干净、模块化且适合初学者（使用 SeedVR2 Upscaler）

厌倦了下载看起来像一碗纠结的意大利面条、节点挤在一起且零指令的 ComfyUI 工作流程？

Krea 2 工作流程 v1.4是为了一个目标而建立的：绝对清晰。

无论您是完全的初学者还是经验丰富的创作者，正在为 Krea 2 寻找简化的日常驱动程序，此工作流程都可以消除混乱，隐藏不必要的电缆混乱，使用ComfyUI 子图，并在画布上提供分步指导。

✨ 这个工作流程有何不同？

  • 🧹 零意大利面（子图架构）：复杂的节点链（K-Sampler 设置、模型加载器、升级管道）使用子图进行清理和整合。您可以获得整洁的视图，而无需凌乱的布线。

  • ⚡ 集成 SeedVR2 Upscaler（开/关切换）：包括随时可用的高保真 SeedVR2 升级管道。打开它以获得超详细的高分辨率输出，或关闭它以获得快速测试迭代。

  • 🎛️ 电源 LoRA 堆叠器：由 rg Three 的 Power LoRA Loader 驱动。轻松堆叠、启用/禁用和调整多个 LoRA，无需重新布线。

  • 📖 内置备忘单和指南：切勿离开 ComfyUI 来查找设置！交互式 Markdown 指南嵌入在节点旁边，解释：

    • K采样器和分辨率设置

    • LoRA 堆叠最佳实践

    • SeedVR2 Upscaler 参数备忘单

    • 便携式安装和节点故障排除指南

  • 🏎️ NVIDIA Blackwell（RTX 50 系列）就绪：包括针对 Blackwell 硬件用户的快速切换修复，以及标准 PyTorch 后备指南。

📦 工作流程分解

┌──────────────┐ ┐────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐
│ 模型加载器 │ ──► │ LoRA Stacker │ ──► │ 提示和采样器 │ ──► │ SeedVR2 │
│ (Krea 2 引擎 │ │ (rg Three) │ │ (子图块) │ 升频器 (ON/OFF)
└────────────────┘ └────────────────┘ └──────────────────┘ └──────────────┘

  1. 模型装载机部分：干净快速地加载您的 Krea 2 扩散模型、文本编码器和 VAE。

  2. LoRA 堆叠器：轻松调整强度权重以定制样式和细节 LoRA。

  3. 发电控制中心：所有关键设置（提示、长宽比、种子、步数、CFG、降噪）都集中在一个组织良好的面板中。

  4. SeedVR2 升级阶段：使用简单的旁路开关打开或关闭高分辨率细化。

  5. 画布上的文档：用于故障排除、设置说明和设置提示的专用浮动注释卡。

🎯 预期结果

  • 生成清晰、高细节的图像：专为 Krea 2 型号 (krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled / Krea2-Engineer-V1-bf16) 打造。

  • 快速迭代：在关闭放大的情况下运行快速预览，然后轻按一个开关即可使用 SeedVR2 渲染完整的 2K/4K 主副本。

  • 无压力定制：交换模型、添加 LoRA 或更改纵横比，而无需中断连接。

⚙️ 所需的自定义节点

为了确保首次启动时一切顺利运行，请确保您通过以下方式安装了这些自定义节点套件舒适UI管理器:

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes（用于设置/获取路线组织）

  • rg Three-comfy（适用于 Power LoRA 加载器和快速旁路器）

  • Seedvr2_videoupscaler（用于 SeedVR2 放大管道）

  • comfyui-扩散-模型加载器-带名称（可选/包含，具体取决于构建）

（如果任何节点在导入时显示红色，只需单击ComfyUI Manager ➔ 安装缺少的自定义节点并重新启动！）

💡 快速入门指南

  1. 将 .json 文件拖放到 ComfyUI 窗口中。

  2. 检查型号面板以确保选择您的 Krea 2 型号。

  3. 在中输入您的提示提示与设置盒子。

  4. 套装高档开/关取决于您是否想要即时渲染或高分辨率升级。

  5. 命中排队提示!

反馈、问题或请求？请在下面发表评论！享受清洁发电！

🚀 Krea 2 Workflow v1.4 | Clean, Modular & Beginner-Friendly (with SeedVR2 Upscaler)

Tired of downloading ComfyUI workflows that look like a tangled bowl of spaghetti, with nodes crammed together and zero instructions?

Krea 2 Workflow v1.4was built with a single goal:Absolute clarity.

Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced creator looking for a streamlined daily driver for Krea 2, this workflow eliminates the clutter, hides unnecessary cable chaos usingComfyUI Subgraphs, and provides step-by-step guidance right on the canvas.

✨ What Makes This Workflow Different?

  • 🧹 Zero Spaghetti (Subgraph Architecture):Complex node chains (K-Sampler setups, model loaders, upscaler pipes) are clean and consolidated using Subgraphs. You get an uncluttered view without messy wire routing.

  • ⚡ Integrated SeedVR2 Upscaler (ON / OFF Toggle):Includes a high-fidelity SeedVR2 upscaling pipeline ready to go. Turn it on for ultra-detailed high-res outputs or toggle it off for fast test iterations.

  • 🎛️ Power LoRA Stacker:Driven by rgthree's Power LoRA Loader. Effortlessly stack, enable/disable, and tweak multiple LoRAs without rerouting a single wire.

  • 📖 Built-In Cheat Sheets & Guides:Never leave ComfyUI to look up settings! Interactive Markdown guides are embedded right next to the nodes, explaining:

    • KSampler & Resolution settings

    • LoRA stacking best practices

    • SeedVR2 Upscaler parameter cheat sheet

    • Portable installation & node troubleshooting guide

  • 🏎️ NVIDIA Blackwell (RTX 50-Series) Ready:Includes a quick toggle fix for Blackwell hardware users, as well as standard PyTorch fallback guidance.

📦 Workflow Breakdown

┌────────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐
│ Model Loader │ ──► │ LoRA Stacker │ ──► │ Prompt & Sampler │ ──► │ SeedVR2 │
│ (Krea 2 Engine│ │ (rgthree) │ │ (Subgraph Block) │ │ Upscaler (ON/OFF)
└────────────────┘ └────────────────┘ └──────────────────┘ └────────────────┘

  1. Model Loader Section:Loads your Krea 2 diffusion model, text encoder, and VAE clean and fast.

  2. LoRA Stacker:Easily adjust strength weights for custom style and detail LoRAs.

  3. Generation Control Center:All your key settings (Prompt, Aspect Ratio, Seed, Steps, CFG, Denoise) in one organized panel.

  4. SeedVR2 Upscaler Phase:Turn high-res refinement on or off with an easy bypass switch.

  5. On-Canvas Documentation:Dedicated floating note cards for troubleshooting, settings explanations, and setup tips.

🎯 Expected Results

  • Crisp, High-Detail Image Generation:Purpose-built for Krea 2 models (krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled / Krea2-Engineer-V1-bf16).

  • Fast Iterations:Run quick previews with upscaling off, then flick one switch to render full 2K/4K master copies using SeedVR2.

  • Stress-Free Customization:Swap models, add LoRAs, or change aspect ratios without breaking connections.

⚙️ Required Custom Nodes

To ensure everything runs smoothly on first launch, make sure you have these custom node suites installed viaComfyUI Manager:

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes (For Set/Get route organization)

  • rgthree-comfy (For Power LoRA Loader & Fast Bypassers)

  • seedvr2_videoupscaler (For SeedVR2 upscaling pipeline)

  • comfyui-diffusion-model-loader-with-name(optional/included depending on build)

(If any node shows red on import, simply clickComfyUI Manager ➔ Install Missing Custom Nodesand restart!)

💡 Quick Start Guide

  1. Drop the .json file into your ComfyUI window.

  2. Check theModel Panelon the left to ensure your Krea 2 models are selected.

  3. Type your prompt in thePrompt & Settingsbox.

  4. SetUpscale ON/OFFdepending on whether you want instant renders or high-res upscaling.

  5. HitQueue Prompt!

Feedback, questions, or requests? Leave a comment below! Enjoy clean generating!
